name: SC Agrotech Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1990, SC Agrotech Ltd is in the business of Agriculture, including horticulture and organic farming.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
SCAL, formerly in the dairy business, producing items such as dairy whitener, skim milk, and desi ghee, faced financial difficulties and pivoted to the biotechnology and agriculture sector. It now offers eco-friendly solutions in organic farming, crop management, and agricultural machinery.

cons: Stock is trading at 3.34 times its book value
Company has a low return on equity of -33.9% over last 3 years.
